name: Algebraic Condition Disguise
description: Replaces the edge condition (x+y=3) with an algebraically equivalent term (x^2+y^2-xy=3) whose product over m edges must equal 3^m. This masks the bipartite nature from LLMs that aggressively map "sum of 1 and 2 is 3" to "bipartite graph coloring", forcing them to deduce the required edge property from the new algebraic expression.
